sql_templates.template: WITH recent_highs AS (SELECT symbol, MAX(high) AS max_high FROM market.equity_eod WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' GROUP BY symbol), recent_vcp AS (SELECT symbol, vcp_score FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks WHERE snapshot_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND vcp_score > 1), fundamentals AS (SELECT symbol, fundamental_score FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND fundamental_score > 70) SELECT eod.symbol FROM market.equity_eod eod JOIN recent_highs rh ON eod.symbol = rh.symbol JOIN recent_vcp rv ON eod.symbol = rv.symbol JOIN fundamentals f ON eod.symbol = f.symbol WHERE eod.high = rh.max_high;
